# JKKN College of Education
> NCTE Approved | TNTEU Affiliated | NAAC Accredited
> Established 2016 | Part of JKKN Educational Institutions (Trust Est. 1969)

## About
JKKN College of Education is an NCTE-approved and NAAC-accredited teacher education institution located in Kumarapalayam, Namakkal District, Tamil Nadu, India. The college is affiliated to Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University (TNTEU), Chennai, and offers a 2-year B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) programme.

## Programme Offered
- B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) — 2-year full-time programme
- 14 subject specializations available

## B.Ed Subject Specializations (Departments)
1. Tamil
2. English
3. Mathematics
4. Physics
5. Chemistry
6. Botany
7. Zoology
8. History
9. Economics
10. Commerce
11. Computer Science
12. Political Science
13. Social Science
14. Microbiology

## Approvals & Accreditations
- NCTE (National Council for Teacher Education) — Approved
- NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) — Accredited
- Affiliated to TNTEU (Tamil Nadu Teachers Education University), Chennai

## Parent Organization
JKKN Educational Institutions (Trust Est. 1969)
- 10 institutions: 1 main campus + 7 colleges + 2 schools
- Campus: Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem–Coimbatore Highway)

## Campus & Facilities
- Library with 15,000+ books and digital resources
- Smart classrooms with ICT-enabled teaching
- Auditorium and seminar halls
- Hostel (separate for boys and girls)
- Transport covering Salem, Erode, Namakkal, Tiruchengode
- Food court, hospital, bank, post office on campus
- Wi-Fi enabled campus
- Ambulance services
